title: Dunjunz, unofficial sideways RAM hack
notes: The four game files of Disc060-DunjunzRx2.ssd from the BBC Micro Games Archive, an unofficial conversion that keeps all 25 levels in two banks of sideways RAM as ROMFS images. Dunjun4 (&0400, 2304 bytes), Dunjun7 (&0D00, 1024 bytes, the figures above; the game starts at &0D31), Dunjun5 (&1100, 7936 bytes) and Dunjun6 (&6E80, 4480 bytes). Its code is Ole's crack's with the official disc's level check and a level loader that calls the ROM filing system's FILEV handler directly. The listing saves all four files.
